Our Story

Built From the Ground Up —
By Engineers, For Industry

Pitech was founded with a singular mission: to eliminate paper-based, inefficient manual processes inside manufacturing and service companies. We are a technology solutions provider specializing in Digitization, IoT Integration, and Custom Software Development — and we have walked the same journey ourselves first.

🎯 Our Mission

Convert every manual internal process into a smart digital workflow using our own in-house software platforms — starting with ourselves, then scaling to our clients.

🔭 Our Vision

Become India's leading Industry 4.0 solutions provider — empowering manufacturers with IoT, traceability and connected intelligence across every production floor.
